However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses DETAILED TERMS AND CONDITIONS ARE GIVEN BELOW: QUANTITY The Successful bidder shall be appointed as Conjoint Surveyor for testing and calibration of weighsca le, supervision of weighment, sampling, sample preparation and moisture determination for sale of 1 8,000 WMT +/- 10% Copper Concentrate of Malanjkhand Copper Project (MCP), Malanjkhand, Madhy a Pradesh during 3 months period, at MCP Unit. The material shall be despatched in Rake loads of a pprox. 2,700WMT each or as per Buyer’s transportation arrangement. The above ordered quantity and delivery schedule are indicative. However, HCL also reserves the rig ht to despatch material as per availability of stock and requirement of HCL and does not guarantee a ny minimum volume of work. However, in case of exigency, the contract quantity may be increased by one rake load along with ti me extension of 30 days. SCOPE OF WORK

The following activities shall have to be undertaken by the Surveyor along with HCL representative: · Scope of work at MCP Unit during dispatch of Copper Concentrate: i) Testing and calibration of the weighscale ii) Supervision of weighment operation iii) Sampling, sample preparation and moisture determination iv) Eight sample shall be prepared for each lot of material OR as per instruction v) Couriering Umpire and Buyer samples as per HCL’s instructions. Note: Umpire Samples to be safely held by the Successful bidder and to be destroyed only after conf irmation of the same from HCL. The above-mentioned scope of work is to be undertaken by successful bidder at HCL’s works, at the time of loading of copper concentrate prior to despatch, HCL personnel shall be closely associated at all stages of the above scope of work All the above work should be carried out in accordance with internationally accepted standard proce dure and as per the terms of Sale Contract of HCL. Free Boarding, Lodging and free local transportation at Unit will be provided by HCL. Validity: The appointment shall be valid for three months from the date of LOI/WO. The entire activities are t o be completed within the shortest possible time. However, in case of exigency, the period may be i ncreased by one month for completion of rake/lot quantity. Taxes and Duties: GST as applicable shall be borne by HCL. GST registration number must be mentioned in the Invoice for claiming service tax. Income Tax & other taxes, if any will be deducted from the payable amount as applicable at the time of payment Risk & Cost: HCL reserves the right to get the work done by another surveyor in the event of your failure to give satisfactory service or for violation of any terms and condition of the contract at your risk and cost. T he decision of HCL/Kolkata shall be final and binding on you.

Bid Validity: 30 days from the tender opening date Sub-Contract: Sub contract will not be allowed in part or whole under any circumstances. Thanking you, For Hindustan Copper Limite d (Ajay Chand raker) GM (Materials & Contracts) .
